dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>We'd like to invite you to attend this music festival.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Is there a music event going on in the city? I'm only familiar with flowers, though, not music.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nah, this one's taking place in Inazuma. And it's totally fine if you don't know much about music, you just need to enjoy it! If there's a tune you like, we could play it for you right now, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Well... I do have something in mind. Its name escapes me, but I can hum the tune, at least. Will that do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll give it a go.
